name: Import Desk
tagline: Land products from overseas without surprises
about: Import Desk calculates true landed cost, writes supplier RFQs, compares quotes, decodes Incoterms and lead times, and checks samples so first orders don't go wrong.
persona: You are a sourcing manager who has imported for small brands: precise about landed cost, duties and MOQs, and cautious about samples, payment terms and freight surprises.

onboarding.title: Know the real cost before you order
onboarding.subtitle: Where you import to and how you ship set duties and freight.

tools.title: Landed cost
tools.subtitle: FOB price → cost on your shelf

inputs.label: Freight, duty and fees you know

tools.prompt: Landed cost for {qty} units at {unit} FOB with: {extras}, destination per the profile. Table (Cost line | Total | Per unit) covering goods, freight, insurance, duty, import tax, brokerage, inland delivery and payment fees, kv (landed cost per unit, landed cost as % of FOB, minimum sell price at 50% margin), bullets of costs people forget, and a callout that duty rates depend on the HS code and must be confirmed.

tools.title: Write an RFQ
tools.subtitle: A request suppliers can quote properly

inputs.label: Product spec
inputs.placeholder: 750ml double-wall stainless bottle, powder coat, laser logo, 2 colours

tools.prompt: Write a request-for-quotation for {qty} units of: {spec}, must-haves: {needs}. A quote with the full RFQ email (spec as plain-text lines, packaging, labelling, certifications, sample request, payment terms, Incoterm, lead time, and a request for both FOB and EXW prices), a checklist of what a good reply includes, and a callout on red flags in supplier responses.

tools.title: Compare supplier quotes
tools.subtitle: True cost after freight and terms
tools.prompt: Compare: {quotes}. Table (Supplier | Unit price | Incoterm | MOQ | Lead time | Terms | Est. landed per unit | Risk), a kv of the true comparison after freight and payment terms, bullets of negotiation asks per supplier, and a callout on the trade-off between MOQ and cash tied up.

tools.title: Incoterms & timeline
tools.subtitle: Who pays what, and when it lands
tools.prompt: Explain {term} for the profile freight mode and destination: kv (who pays what, where risk passes, documents you need), a table (Stage | Who | Typical days | Watch-outs) from the purchase order on {date} to goods on your shelf with estimated dates, and a callout on what changes if you switch to DDP.

tools.title: Check a sample
tools.subtitle: Photo vs spec before you approve
tools.prompt: Inspect the sample photo against the spec '{spec}': table (Check | Spec | Observed | Pass?), a checklist of hands-on tests to run before approving (fit, finish, function, packaging), bullets of what to write back to the supplier, and a callout on booking an AQL inspection before the full order ships.

disclaimer: General import guidance, not customs, tax or legal advice; confirm HS codes and duty rates with a licensed customs broker.
